required_concepts: a rhombus has two pairs of equal adjacent sides
a rhombus has four equal sides
optional_concepts: kite definition includes two pairs of equal adjacent sides
acceptable_paraphrases: Rhombus is a special type of kite
All sides are equal in a rhombus
Opposite sides of a rhombus are equal
critical_errors: mistaking the definition of a kite with other quadrilaterals
misconceptions: A rhombus is just like a kite but shorter
A rhombus can be any shape as long as the sides are not all equal
A rhombus and a kite have different definitions
A kite has more than two pairs of adjacent sides
grading_notes: Credit should be given for understanding that a rhombus is a special type of kite based on side properties. Incorrectly stating the definition of a kite or confusing shapes will result in deductions.
